transitions.note: IPC/CrPC/Indian Evidence Act repealed and replaced nationwide (BNS/BNSS/BSA) for offences/procedures on or after this date; the old codes still apply to pre-cutover events.

The four central Labour Codes were notified for nationwide enforcement on 21 Nov 2025, superseding the listed Acts for events/disputes on or after that date; the old Acts still apply to pre-cutover events.
